Import reads a folder you pick, once, and copies what it finds into GBee.

Battery saves: .sav, .srm and .sa1 files, from GBee or from other emulators (mGBA, My Boy!, Pizza Boy, RetroArch and others). This is the save the game itself writes, and every emulator can read it. Each file is matched to a game in your library by its name. If no game matches, tap Pick game. Accepted sizes: 512 B, 8 KB, 32 KB, 64 KB and 128 KB (or 16 B more). NO$GBA compressed saves are not accepted.

Save states: only GBee's own (.slotN.gbstate files, made by Export). Save states from other emulators cannot be read, because each emulator writes them in its own private format. In the other emulator, save in the game first, then import that battery save.

Nothing is lost: if a game already has a save, or a state in that slot, the current one is kept as a backup.

Close the game first. A game that is open in the emulator is not imported.

Export copies your GBee saves into a folder you pick.

Battery saves are written as <game name>.sav, the file other emulators read. If the folder already has a save for that game, its name is reused (for example .srm), and the old file is backed up in GBee first.

Save states are written as <game name>.slotN.gbstate, with achievement progress in a .gbra file beside it. Only GBee can load them. Use them to move to a new phone or to keep a backup, and bring them back with Import.

Fully close the other emulator first, or it may overwrite these files. The game that is open in GBee is saved before the export.

GBee can download box art for your games from the libretro thumbnail server (thumbnails.libretro.com). Only each game\'s official No-Intro name is sent, never your file names.\n\nYou can change this later in Settings.
